pages.title: Rainbow Friends Blue Wearing His Tilted Crown with Drool Hanging From His Mouth Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rainbow Friends Blue wearing his tilted crown, with a button eye, broad grin, and drool hanging from his mouth. His rounded arms, large feet, and wide torso provide open spaces on the coloring sheet, while the crossed stitching and crown points add smaller details.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Green Standing with Googly Eyes and His Tongue Sticking Out Coloring Page
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Green stands with googly eyes and his tongue sticking out in this printable coloring page, with long arms hanging beside his narrow body. Rounded fingers and oversized feet create clear shapes on the coloring sheet, while his row of square teeth and eye outlines form smaller enclosed sections.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Orange Showing His Pointed Teeth and Long Lizard Tail Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Rainbow Friends Orange showing his pointed teeth and long lizard tail, with raised claws and bent legs beneath his snout. The curling tail and large feet give the coloring sheet a strong silhouette, while closely spaced triangular teeth and individual toe claws add finer sections.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Purple Peeking Through a Floor Vent Beside a Puddle Coloring Page
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Purple peeks through a floor vent beside a puddle in this printable coloring page, resting both hands over the edge beneath his eyes. The vent's slats and corner screws add small details to the coloring sheet, and the tiled floor divides the space around the irregular puddle.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Red the Scientist Wearing His Lab Coat and Gloves Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rainbow Friends Red the scientist wearing his lab coat and gloves, with oversized eyes above a tie and buttoned vest. His coat pockets, rolled cuffs, and thick shoe soles divide the outfit into distinct sections, giving this coloring sheet a mix of broad areas and small clothing details.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Cyan Showing Her Two Horns and Curved Tail Coloring Page
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Cyan shows her two horns and curved tail in this printable coloring page, standing on clawed feet with her toothy mouth opened wide. Large spaces across the head and body anchor the coloring sheet, with smaller pointed sections inside the jaws, along the horns, and across the toes.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Lookies Lined Up with Their Round Bodies and Large Eyes Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows six Rainbow Friends Lookies lined up in two rows, each with a round body and a pair of large eyes. The overlapping circles make the group arrangement clear on the coloring sheet, with open body areas surrounding the smaller oval pupils and separate eye outlines.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Chapter 1 Blue Green Orange Purple and Red Gathered Together Coloring Page
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Chapter 1 characters Blue, Green, Orange, Purple, and Red gather together in this printable coloring page, with tall Green rising behind the group. Blue's crown, Red's lab coat, Orange's pointed teeth, and Purple's long limbs distinguish the figures, making this coloring sheet a collection of large silhouettes and smaller facial details.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Blue Sitting on His Castle Throne Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rainbow Friends Blue sitting on his castle throne, with his crown above a button eye and drool beneath his grin. His hands rest on wide armrests between tall posts, while an arched stone backdrop and tiled floor frame the large central figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Blue Looking at a Cardboard Box with a Roblox Player Hiding Inside Coloring Page
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Blue looks at a cardboard box with a Roblox player hiding inside in this printable coloring page, leaning toward the open flaps below. The player's hair and eyes appear above the box edge, adding small details beside Blue's broad body and the large rectangular panels of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Green Feeling His Way Along a Hallway Wall Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rainbow Friends Green feeling his way along a hallway wall, with one long arm extended beside a closed door. His protruding eyes and hanging tongue stand out against the plain corridor, while the doorframe, baseboards, and long limbs create narrow sections throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Green Entering Through the Fenced Passage Coloring Page
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Green enters through a fenced passage in this printable coloring page, holding the open gate with one hand as he steps between posts. The chain-link mesh forms many small diamond spaces across the coloring sheet, contrasting with Green's long body, broad feet, and the scattered grass tufts below.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Green Blocking a Roblox Player Collecting Food Packs Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rainbow Friends Green blocking a Roblox player collecting food packs, with the tall monster standing across a narrow corridor. The player holds one packet beside a shelf carrying two more, and the coloring sheet combines broad character shapes with smaller hair, wrapper, and shelf details.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Orange Resting on the Rocky Ledge Above His Food Bowl Coloring Page
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Orange rests on a rocky ledge above his food bowl in this printable coloring page, with his long tail curling around his body. His small claws grip the ledge beneath an open, toothy snout, while irregular cave walls, loose stones, and the oval bowl add background sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Orange Running Along His Marked Trail Through the Facility Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Rainbow Friends Orange running along his marked trail through the facility, with lifted feet and curved claws beside his body. A winding double line follows the floor past doorways and wall panels, while overhead pipes add long narrow spaces above the character on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Orange Waiting Beside a Cavern Track as a Roller Coaster Cart Approaches Coloring Page
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Orange waits beside a cavern track as a roller coaster cart approaches in this printable coloring page, standing near the curving rails. His raised claws and pointed teeth fill the foreground, while the distant wheeled cart, repeated track ties, and angular rock walls give the coloring sheet smaller background details.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Purple Appearing with His Hands Above the Mist in His Lair Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rainbow Friends Purple appearing with his hands above the mist in his lair, raising spread fingers beneath his large eyes. Curling bands of fog surround his long arms, and the jagged cave walls divide the background into irregular shapes across this detailed character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Red Using a Remote to Release Blue and Green From the Garage Coloring Page
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Red uses a remote to release Blue and Green from the garage in this printable coloring page, standing before a partly raised door. The remote's antenna, Red's buttoned vest, Blue's crown, and Green's long fingers add distinct details, with wide door panels and floor sections around the three figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Red the Scientist Standing Beside the Escape Vent Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rainbow Friends Red the scientist standing beside the escape vent, extending a gloved hand toward its open slatted cover. His long coat, vest buttons, and tie add clothing sections, while the square opening and hinged grille provide straight-edged details beside the large figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Cyan Inspecting a Cardboard Box with a Roblox Player Hiding Inside Coloring Page
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Cyan inspects a cardboard box with a Roblox player hiding inside in this printable coloring page, bending her horned head toward the opening. The player grips the box flaps and looks upward, while Cyan's curved tail, clawed feet, and the fence behind them create distinct sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Lookies Rolling Around the Odd World Windmill Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rainbow Friends Lookies rolling around the Odd World windmill, with four round characters scattered along a winding path through hills. Curved motion marks surround their bodies, and the windmill's segmented blades, small window, fence, and grass tufts provide finer background details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Blue Standing Beside His First Friend in Front of a Brick Wall Coloring Page
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Blue stands beside his first friend in front of a brick wall in this printable coloring page, both facing forward with open smiles. The smaller Roblox figure wears a cap and striped shirt, adding narrow clothing sections beside Blue's broad silhouette and the repeated rectangular bricks on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Blue Dressed as Santa Claus in a Coat and Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Rainbow Friends Blue dressed as Santa Claus in a coat and hat, with his crown rising above the fluffy brim. A wide buckled belt, scalloped cuffs, and pom-pom divide the costume into clear sections, while Blue's button eye and hanging drool remain visible on the Christmas coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Blue in a Vampire Cape Green in a Skeleton Costume and Orange in a Witch Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rainbow Friends Blue in a vampire cape, Green in a skeleton costume, and Orange in a witch hat standing together. Blue's high collar and round clasp frame his face, while Green's outlined bones and Orange's bent hat add smaller costume sections across the Halloween coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Baby Blue Green and Orange Sitting Together on a Bench Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rainbow Friends Baby Blue, Green, and Orange sitting together on a bench, with Green between his two smaller companions. Blue's crown and drool, Green's hanging tongue, and Orange's curled tail distinguish the seated figures, while bench slats and small grass tufts add background details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Cyborg Blue with a Mechanical Arm and Robotic Eye Coloring Page
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Cyborg Blue stands with a mechanical arm and robotic eye in this printable coloring page, wearing a crown above his partly paneled face. Circular joints, bolts, and a segmented claw hand create small enclosed areas beside the broad torso, while his button eye and drooling grin remain prominent on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Blue Standing Beside Huggy Wuggy Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rainbow Friends Blue standing beside Huggy Wuggy, with Blue's rounded silhouette next to the taller character's long, shaggy limbs. Huggy Wuggy's bow and closely packed pointed teeth add small details, while Blue's crown, button eye, and broad body offer larger sections across the two-character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Blue Eating a Slice of Pizza Coloring Page
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Blue eats a slice of pizza in this printable coloring page, holding the crust beside his open mouth beneath his tilted crown. Round toppings and hanging cheese form small shapes near his hand, while the button eye, drool, and broad body keep the character clearly defined on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Blue Green and Orange Riding Together on a Bus Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Rainbow Friends Blue, Green, and Orange riding together on a bus, looking out through its front and side windows. The vehicle's round headlights, striped grille, mirrors, and large wheels add distinct sections, with broad side panels and short road markings surrounding the characters on the coloring sheet.
